αἰχμητὴν: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. acc. sg., predicate accusative with an infinitive
αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἶψά: αἶψα — quickly, soon, at once; adv.
αὐτοί: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourselves’ (χαίρετε δ’ αὐτοί ’and fare well yourselves’) · also masc. nom. pl. with a 1st-person subject: ’ourselves’ (αὐτοί τ’ ἀμβαίνωμεν ’and let us ourselves embark’)
αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼ … αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’you yourself’ (ὄφρα καὶ αὐτός ’so that you too yourself’)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’him(self)’ · also reinforcing σε: ’you yourself’ (σ’ αὐτὸν) · also acc. sg. reinforcing an unexpressed 1st-person pronoun: ’me myself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ ἐνθάδ’ ἔχουσα ’keeping me myself here’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, after a preposition: ἀμφ’ αὐτὸν ’around him’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun of a thing, unemphatic ’it’ (masc. χιτών), as direct object of a verb: ἐθηήσαντο αὐτὸν ’gazed at it’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, direct object of a verb: θεὸς αὐτὸν ἐνείκαι ’a god might bring him’
αὖτέ: αὖτε — again, on the other hand; adv., accented αὖτέ before the enclitic τις (same word as αὖτε)
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’cast’ · also ’hit, strike’, with the person or part struck as object: ’struck’ (βάλε δεξιὸν ὦμον ’struck the right shoulder’)
βάλλεο: βάλλω — throw, put; mid. put (in one’s mind); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic βάλλου)
βεβήκει: βαίνω — go, walk, step; plpf. 3 sg. with simple past force (Homeric pluperfect): ’had gone, went’
βουλὴν: βουλή — counsel, plan, advice; fem. acc. sg.
βροτοί: βροτός — mortal, as opposed to a god; masc. nom. pl.: ’mortals’
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
γείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear (of a mother); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐγείνατο)
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
δειλός: δειλός — wretched, miserable; also, in other contexts, cowardly; masc. nom. sg.
δόντες: δίδωμι — give; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having given’
δῶρ: δῶρον — gift; neut. nom. pl., elided (δῶρ’ = δῶρα)
εἰρύαται: ἐρύω — draw, haul; perf. mid./pass. 3 pl., epic -αται (for -νται): ’are drawn up’ (of ships) · also ἐρύομαι (εἰρύομαι) ’guard, watch for’; perf. mid. 3 pl. with pres. sense, epic -αται (for -νται): ’are lying in wait for’
εἴδεται: εἴδομαι — seem, appear (with inf.); pres. mid. 3 sg.: ’seems’
εἴπῃ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’he may tell’
εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
εἷσεν: ἵζω — seat, set; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’seated (her)’ · also ’settled (a people in a new land)’
εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
εὖτ: εὖτε (elided εὖτ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj.
θέμιστας: θέμις — custom, established right, ordinance; fem. acc. pl.: ’ordinances, customary rights’
θησέα: Θησεύς — Theseus, hero of Athens; masc. acc. sg.
θοὴν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
θοῇ: θοός — swift, quick (standing epithet of ships); fem. dat. sg.
θωρηχθῆναι: θωρήσσω (mid. θωρήσσομαι) — arm, put on armour; aor. pass. inf. with middle sense: ’to arm oneself’
κακοῖο: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ) (πῆμα κακοῖο ’woe of evil, i.e. woe upon woe’, an intensifying genitive)
κείνοισι: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic ἐκείνοις)
κελαινὸν: κελαινός — dark, black; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with αἷμα
κεχολωμένον: χολόω — make angry; pass. be angry, enraged; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’in a state of anger’
κεῖνοι: ἐκεῖνος — that, he; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl., epic κεῖνος (= Attic ἐκεῖνος): ’those men’
κλισίας: κλισίη — hut, shelter (of soldiers or herdsmen); fem. acc. pl., epic (= Attic κλισία)
κραδίην: κραδίη — heart (epic = Attic καρδία); fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ην
κὴρ: κήρ — death-spirit, power of death, doom; fem. nom. sg., personified (distinct from κῆρ ’heart’)
κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. nom./acc. sg.
λέλοιπεν: λείπω — leave, forsake; perf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’has left’
λίσσομ: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; pres. 1 sg., elided (λίσσομ’ = λίσσομαι)
λιγὺς: λιγύς — clear-sounding, shrill, whistling; masc. nom. sg., usually of voices/instruments but here of wind (λιγὺς οὖρος ’a clear, keen wind’)
λόχον: λόχος — ambush, body of men lying in wait; masc. acc. sg. (of the men hidden inside the wooden horse)
λῦσαν: λύω — loose, unyoke; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they loosed’
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
μέγας: μέγας — great, big, grown; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’grown’ · also plain attributive adj., masc. nom. sg., ’great, huge’ (μέγας σῦς ’a great boar’), not predicate
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’) · also neut. nom. sg. in the periphrasis ἱερὸν μένος Ἀλκινόοιο: ’the sacred strength of Alcinous’, a periphrasis for Alcinous himself
μήτε: μήτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black; standing epithet of ships; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα · also modifying a different noun, not a ship (μελαίνῃ φρικί ’with a dark ripple’, of the sea’s surface)
μερόπων: μέροψ — epithet of men, ’mortal’ or ’speech-dividing’ (meaning uncertain); masc. gen. pl.
μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj., companion to μή
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μὴν: μήν — truly, indeed; affirmative particle; καὶ μὴν ’and moreover, and further’
νέστωρ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νηῒ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables)
οἵδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’these here’
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; neut. as exclamatory adv.: ’how!, what a thing!’ (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also causal conj. after a verb of emotion, ’in that, that’ · also correlative ’such as, as’ (οἷον ὅτε πρώτιστον ’such as when first’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τὸν Τηλεφίδην: ’what a man, such a one as’ (ἀλλ’ οἷον … κατενήρατο ’but what a man he slew’) · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with ἦμαρ: ’of such a kind as’ (οἷον ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ἄγησι ’such as the day he brings’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’what sort of (strength)’
οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ (μετὰ οἷς ἑτάροισι ’among his own companions’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; masc./neut. dat. pl. (οἷς ἔπι ’on which’, of the stones)
οὐδὲν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc./nom. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’ · also neut. nom. sg. as subject: ’nothing’ (οὐδὲν γλύκιον … γίγνεται ’nothing is sweeter’) · also neut. acc. sg. as object of a verb, with a comparative: ’nothing (slighter)’ (οὐδὲν ἀκιδνότερον … γαῖα τρέφει ’the earth nourishes nothing slighter’)
οὐτιδανὸς: οὐτιδανός — worthless, good-for-nothing; masc. nom. sg.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πάντεσσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πᾶσι)
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
πίθεσθε: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’obey’
πίθηαι: πείθομαι — be persuaded, obey; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πίθῃ)
παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
παῦε: παύω — stop, make cease; pres. imper. act. 2 sg.
πείθεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey, comply with (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.
πείθοντό: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, comply with (+ dat.); impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπείθοντο), acute on the last syllable before enclitic τε: ’they obeyed’
πείρησαι: πειράω — try, test, make trial of (+ gen.); aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’try’
πείσεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid./pass. fut. inf. πείσεσθαι: ’to be persuaded, to be won over’ (οὐ πείσεσθαι ἔμελλεν ’he was not to win her over’) · also πάσχω — suffer, experience; fut. inf. πείσεσθαι (πείσομαι): ’to suffer’ (κακὸν πείσεσθαι ’to suffer evil’)
πειρίθοόν: Πειρίθοος — Pirithous, king of the Lapiths, friend of Theseus; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’) · also + dat., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (περὶ κτεάτεσσι μαχειόμενος ’fighting over possessions’) · also + gen., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (fighting over a person) · also + acc. of the occupation: ’about, at’ (περὶ δεῖπνον πένοντο ’busied themselves about the meal’)
πλεόνεσσιν: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλείων ’more, several’, masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic πλείοσιν)
ποθ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided before a rough breathing (ποθ’ = ποτέ)
ποθὴ: ποθή — longing, want, need (+ gen.); fem. nom. sg.
ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πολύφημον: Πολύφημος — Polyphemus, the Cyclops blinded by Odysseus, son of Poseidon; acc. sg.
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’ · also + dat., ’on, upon’: ποτὶ χθονί ’on the ground’ · also + dat., ’to’ a person: ποτὶ οἷ ’to himself’
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. (τὸ πρόσθεν ’in time past, formerly’) · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, before’
πυλίων: Πύλιος — Pylian, of Pylos; masc. gen. pl.
πόποι: πόποι — (in ὢ πόποι) exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! well!’; origin unknown
πύλου: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; gen. sg.
πύλῳ: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese; fem. dat. sg.
πᾶν: πᾶς — all, whole; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with πεδίον: ’the whole (plain)’ · also neut. nom. sg. as a plain substantive: ’all, everything’ (οὔ πω πᾶν εἴρηθ’ ’not yet had everything been said’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’the whole’ (πᾶν μέγαρον ’the whole hall’)
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
σημαίνειν: σημαίνω — give orders, command; pres. inf. act. (+ ἐπί + dat.: ’over’)
σκηπτοῦχος: σκηπτοῦχος — sceptre-holding, sceptred; masc. nom. sg.
σφῶϊν: σύ (dual σφῶϊ) — you two; dual gen./dat. 2nd person, epic (= Attic σφῷν): ’from you two’
σχέθε: ἔχω — hold, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔσχε)
σύν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σύν … ἄραξε ’would smash together’)
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also with a noun, neut. acc. pl.: ’these’ (τάδε δώμαθ’ ’this house’, plural for one dwelling) · also with a noun, neut. nom. pl.: ’these’ (τάδε ἔργα ’these deeds’)
ταῦτά: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’, accented before an enclitic
τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’ · also periphrastic with the pres. ἐστίν rather than fut. ἔσται, of a thing already fixed by fate: ’it is a thing ordained, it is decreed’ · also periphrastic with the opt. εἴη, in a wish: ’may it be fulfilled’ (τετελεσμένον εἴη)
τηλόθεν: τηλόθεν — from afar, from a distance; adv., ablatival suffix -θεν
τιμῆς: τιμή — honour, worth; fem. gen. sg.
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
τοὔνεκά: τοὔνεκα (τοῦ + ἕνεκα, crasis) — therefore, for that reason; adv., accented before the enclitic τοι
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’ · also relative, masc./neut. dat. pl. ’on which’ (κώεα, τοῖσιν ἐνεῦδεν ’the fleeces on which he had slept’) · also masc. dat. pl. after ἐν, ’among them’ (ἐν … τοῖσιν) · also neut. dat. pl., ’with those’, pointing back to a group of things: τοῖσιν Ὀδυσσῆος ’with those of Odysseus’
τράφεν: τρέφω — nourish, rear, bring up; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐτράφησαν): ’were reared, grew up’
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τόνδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstr. pron., masc. acc. sg., elided (τόνδ’ = τόνδε)
τόσσα: τόσος — so much, so many; epic τόσσος (doubled σ), neut. acc. pl.
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε)
τῳ: τις, τι — someone, anyone; masc./neut. dat. sg. (= τινί), enclitic: ’to anyone’
υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
φορέουσι: φορέω — carry, bear (habitually); pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φοροῦσι)
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, it is right; impersonal verb + acc. and inf. · also + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need of’
χόλοιο: χόλος — anger, bile; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after μεθίημι
ἀέκοντος: ἄκων (ἀέκων) — unwilling; masc. gen. sg., idiom βίῃ ἀέκοντος ’by force, against one’s will’ (gen. loosely agreeing with the person referred to)
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀθηναίης: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic-epic form (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
ἀνάσσει: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
ἀνάσσειν: ἀνάσσω — be lord, rule (+ dat.); pres. inf.: ’to rule (over)’
ἀνέρας: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. pl., epic ἀνέρας (= Attic ἄνδρας)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀντίθεον: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. acc. sg.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’opposite, facing’ (ἀντίον Εὐρυμάχου ’opposite Eurymachus’)
ἀνόρουσε: ἀνορούω — spring up, leap up; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἀνώρουσε)
ἀπίης: ἄπιος — far-off, distant; fem. gen. sg.
ἀπίθησε: ἀπιθέω — disobey; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, negated by οὐδέ: ’did not disobey’
ἀργυρέῃ: ἀργύρεος — of silver; fem. dat. sg.
ἀριστήεσσιν: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. dat. pl., epic -ήεσσιν (= Attic -εῦσιν)
ἀχαιΐδα: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean; adj. of land, fem. acc. sg.
ἀχαιοῖσιν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
ἀχιλλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἀχνύμενός: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’grieved (though I am)’
ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλοισιν: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. pl.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἄνασσεν: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was lord over’ · also + gen.: ’was lord over’ (Κύπρου ἶφι ἄνασσεν ’ruled mightily over Cyprus’)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’best’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’best’ (λαὸν ἄριστον ’the best host’) · also masc. acc. sg. with the article, partitive: τὸν ἄριστον σιάλων ’the best of the hogs’ · also ἄριστον — breakfast, the early meal; neut. acc. sg. (ἐντύνοντο ἄριστον ’prepared breakfast’)
ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’what things’
ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat. · also ἅμα … τε, correlative: ’both … and’ (ἅμα τ’ αὐτῆς Πηνελοπείης … καὶ σέθεν εἵνεκα ’both for Penelope herself and for your sake’)
ἐΐσας: ἐΐσος (ἔΐσος) — equal, even, balanced; fem. acc. pl., epic, agreeing with φρένας: ’well-balanced’
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, happen; aor. 3 pl.: ’became, were’ (ὁμηγερέες ἐγένοντο ’were assembled together’) · also ’were born’ (ἠδ’ ἐγένοντο)
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows) · also accented ἐγώ before the enclitic μιν that follows · also accented before the enclitic τε: σύ τ’ ἐγώ τε ’you and I’ · also accented before the elided enclitic ποτ’ (ποτέ): ἐγώ ποτ’ ’I once’ · also accented before the enclitic περ: ὅσσα τ’ ἐγώ περ ’as much as I’
ἐθέλει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 3 sg.
ἐκπάγλως: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, vehement; adv. ἐκπάγλως: ’terribly, vehemently’
ἐλάφοιο: ἔλαφος — deer, hind; masc./fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐξαῦτις: ἐξαῦτις — again, once more, anew; adv., epic (= Attic αὖθις)
ἐξερέω: ἐξερέω — tell out, declare; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐξερῶ): ’I will tell’
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
ἐπιείκελον: ἐπιείκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., epic
ἐπιχθονίων: ἐπιχθόνιος — upon the earth (epithet of mortals, as against the gods); masc./fem. gen. pl.
ἐρωήσει: ἐρωέω — rush, gush; fut. 3 sg.: ’will gush’
ἐόντες: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντες): ’being’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’ · also εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’ (τοῖος ἔα ’such I was’) · also ἐάω — allow; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἴα): ’allowed’ (οὐκ ἔα ’did not allow’)
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη)
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔθελ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἔθελ’ = ἔθελε)
ἔθεσαν: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 pl.: ’they set’ (with πὰρ in tmesis: ’set before’)
ἔκλυον: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 1 sg. · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they heard’ (οἱ δ’ ἔκλυον ’they heard’)
ἔμμορε: μείρομαι — receive a share; perf. 3 sg. ἔμμορε, + gen.: ’has a share of’
ἔνδοθι: ἔνδοθι — within, inside; adv., with the locative suffix -θι
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition/predicative, naming a maker: ἔργον Ἡφαίστοιο ’the work of Hephaestus’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a passive verb: ’work’ (τόδε ἔργον ἀέξεται ’this work grows’)
ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔσεταί: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic ἔσεται (= Attic ἔσται), accented by the enclitic περ: ’it will be’
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔσται)
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, enclosure; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἠέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic = ἤ), esp. in ἠέ ... ἦ ’either... or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative (λώϊον ἠέ περ ἄλλοι ’better than others’)
ἠγαθέῃ: ἠγάθεος — very holy, sacred (intensive formation); adj., fem. dat. sg. (Πύλῳ ἠγαθέῃ ’holy Pylos’)
ἠμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’answered’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
ἴδωμαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., hortatory: ’let me see’
ἴσχεο: ἴσχω — hold, restrain; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic ἴσχου): ’restrain yourself, hold back’
ἵξεται: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will reach’
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀμοῦμαι: ὄμνυμι — swear; fut. 1 sg. mid. (contracted from ὀμόσσομαι): ’I shall swear’
ὀνείδεα: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt, blame; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀνείδη) · also neut. acc. pl., object: ’reproaches’ (κατ’ ὀνείδεα χεῦαν ’poured reproaches down’)
ὄρεσσι: ὄρος — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ὄρεσι)
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under, beneath; + gen., dat. or acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑφ’ ... ὦρσε = ὑπῶρσε ’aroused’)
ὔμμες: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; nom. pl., epic ὔμμες (= Attic ὑμεῖς)
ὕστατα: ὕστατος — last, latest; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, doubling πύματα for emphasis: ’for the last time’
ὦσε: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔωσε): ’thrust away’
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥέεν: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted, unaugmented (= ἔρρει): ’flowed’
